title: Hollow Knight
review: An absolute masterpiece of tight controls and atmospheric world-building. The Silksong wait is real.

title: Celeste
review: Platforming perfection. The narrative hit harder than expected.

title: Stardew Valley
review: Endlessly cozy. I keep coming back every few months.

title: Outer Wilds
review: The best mystery in gaming. Go in blind.

title: Hades
review: The roguelike that finally clicked for me. One more run syndrome is severe.

title: Dark Souls
review: Respect its craft but bounced off twice before it finally clicked.

title: The Last of Us Part II
review: Technically stunning. Story divisive. The gameplay sections alone carry it.

title: Cyberpunk 2077
review: Redemption arc complete. Night City is a spectacle.

title: Gotham Knights
review: Painfully mediocre. Not bad enough to be interesting.
